# HomeCloud Docs — https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

> HomeCloud user documentation for account owners and DevOps: console guides, CLI, and SDK for every service.

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/getting-started/overview/): What HomeCloud is for users
- [Accounts](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/getting-started/accounts/): Open an account, invites, sign-in
- [Console](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/getting-started/console/): Where things live in the UI
- [Access Keys](https://docs.web.holab.abrdns.com/getting-started/access-keys/): Data-plane credentials for CLI/SDK
